The campus budget risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted-risk assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the judge_reward of 0.73 suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling, the core logic successfully processed the budget-at-risk metrics. Future iterations should verify the stability of the weighting matrix against non-standard input distributions to maintain this success.
